---
title: "Sarasota Rent Map"
---

Explore the 2024 ACS rent estimate for Sarasota, Florida. Select the marker
for the median gross rent and its margin of error.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

library(dplyr)
library(leaflet)
library(readr)

rent_data <- read_csv("sarasota_rent_2024.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
median_rent <- rent_data |>
  filter(variable == "B25064_001") |>
  slice(1)

leaflet() |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
  setView(lng = -82.5307, lat = 27.3364, zoom = 12) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = -82.5307,
    lat = 27.3364,
    radius = 12,
    color = "#ffffff",
    weight = 3,
    fillColor = "#d9485f",
    fillOpacity = 0.9,
    label = "Sarasota, Florida",
    popup = paste0(
      "<strong>Sarasota, Florida</strong><br>",
      "Median gross rent: $",
      format(median_rent$estimate, big.mark = ","),
      " per month<br>",
      "Margin of error: ±$",
      format(median_rent$moe, big.mark = ","),
      "<br><small>2020–2024 ACS 5-year estimate</small>"
    )
  )
```

The marker shows a citywide estimate, not rent differences between
neighborhoods. The Census data in this download does not include locations
within Sarasota.
